long_biography.plain_text:
Republic National Bank of New York gave Koifman a series of senior mandates in Geneva. He became the local general manager, served as treasurer of Safra Republic Holdings and chaired the group's fund-management arm. After the bank's acquisition, he helped establish an independent advisory boutique for wealthy families and institutions.

Today, Koifman's businesses engineer portfolios across venture capital, fixed income and direct co-investments. He also controls a separate advisory company whose mandate spans investment advice and company holdings. He joined Citycon's board in 2019 and became vice chairman in 2021, adding listed-property governance to his investment work.
